models.bounds: Two distinct database/region/queue scopes; one queue creation and one message per scope; at most two receives per message; clock 0..2, delay/visibility 0..1, retention two abstract ticks, two attribute configurations. Cached HTTP queue lookup can interleave with queue deletion. Deleted message/queue row metadata is normalized to zero. Receipt candidates include current, previous, unissued and peer handles; baseline equality admits only the current handle.
models.limits: Atomic transition abstraction after the native parent/expiry/rollback repair. Scopes abstract separately configured database/region/queue targets, not selected IAM principals. Receipt freshness assumes collision-free opaque IDs. No SQL/Go refinement, cryptographic proof, restart/file durability, wall-clock or long-poll liveness, batch/multiple-message atomicity, FIFO/exactly-once/distributed replica behavior, Unicode/size/checksum correctness or full URL validation. Queue name reuse beyond one lifetime is outside the bound; native regression tests separately cover actual storage failures and persistence.

 /\ attributes' = [attributes EXCEPT ![s] = 1 - @]
